svt_mipi_dsi_coverage Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_coverage:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class containing the collection of default coverage groups for MIPI DSI.
These groups are setup to use the default coverage data (packet transaction) provided by the svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_callback class and samples in response to the events triggered by the svt_mipi_dsi_coverage class.
The list of covergroups defined in this class are:

Member CoverGroup Documentation

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_alternate_calibration_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_alternate_calibration_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for Alternate calibration Coverage.
  • coverpoint t_alt_cal_timer_cp -- Data T_ALT_CAL timing parameter will be covered when the transmitter drives the ALTERNATE calibration pattern
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_alternate_calibration_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  type_option.comment = "D-PHY Cover Group for T ALT CAL Timing Parameter Coverage";
   t_alt_cal_timer_cp:coverpoint alternate_cal_timer {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_ALT_CAL timing parameter";
    bins t_alt_cal_min_bin = {[t_alt_cal_min : t_alt_cal_40_percent]};
    bins t_alt_cal_mid_bin = {[t_alt_cal_41_percent : t_alt_cal_70_percent]};
    bins t_alt_cal_max_bin = {[t_alt_cal_71_percent : t_alt_cal_max]};
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_clk_state_machine_error_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_clk_state_machine_error_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Error Scenerios, Physical layer cover point:
  • coverpoint hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_10_11_normal_cp -- Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> LP10 -> Stop(LP11)}
  • coverpoint hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_11_normal_cp -- Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> Stop(LP11)}
  • coverpoint ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_01_11_normal_cp -- Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP01 -> LP11}
  • coverpoint ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_11_normal_cp -- Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP11}
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_clk_state_machine_error_cg;
     option.per_instance = 1;
   option.weight = 1;
   type_option.comment = "D-PHY Clk State Machine Error Cover Group for Error Scenerios, Physical layer Coverage";
        hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_10_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
   {
     type_option.comment = "Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> LP10 -> Stop(LP11)}";
     option.weight = 1;
     bins clock_hs_exc_11_01_10_11_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                          svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_RQST =>
                                          svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::INVALID_STATE =>
                                          svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
   }
        hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
   {
     type_option.comment = "Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> Stop(LP11)}";
     option.weight = 1;
     bins clock_hs_exc_11_01_11_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                       svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_RQST =>
                                       svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
   }
        ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_01_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
   {
     type_option.comment = "Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP01 -> LP11}";
     bins clock_ulps_exc_11_10_01_11_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                            svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::RX_ULPS_RQST =>
                                            svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::INVALID_STATE =>
                                            svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
   }
        ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
   {
     type_option.comment = "Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP11}";
     bins clock_ulps_exc_11_10_11_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                         svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::RX_ULPS_RQST =>
                                         svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
   }
      clk_exception_seq_lp11_00_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
  {
    type_option.comment = "Clock lane exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> Invalid State(LP-00) -> Stop(LP-11)}";
    option.weight = 1;
    bins lp_clk_exc_lp11_00_11_normal_seq_bn = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                                svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::INVALID_STATE =>
                                                svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
  }
        hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_00_01_11_normal_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state
   {
     type_option.comment = "Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> HS-Prpr(LP-00) -> HS-Go(LP-01) -> Stop(LP11)}";
     option.weight = 1;
     bins clock_hs_exc_11_01_00_01_11_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                             svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_RQST =>
                                             svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_PRPR =>
                                             svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_GO =>
                                             svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP);
   }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_clock_global_timing_parameter_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_clock_global_timing_parameter_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for Clock Global Timing Parameter Coverage.
  • coverpoint t_clk_prepare_cp -- Clock T_CLK_PREPARE global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE is equal to time that the transmitter drives the Clock Lane LP-00 Line state immediately before the HS-0 Line state starting the HS transmission.
  • coverpoint t_clk_trail_cp -- Clock T_CLK_TRAIL global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_TRAIL is equal to the time the transmitter drives the flipped differential state after last payload data bit of a HS transmission burst i.e T hs_trail_value
  • coverpoint t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_cp -- Clock T_CLK_PREPARE_CLK_ZERO global timing parameter will be hit coverage when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_GO is the combination of HS_PREPARE time and HS_GO time. Coverage will be hit only in HS mode of transmission. It is not same as SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_CLK
  • coverpoint t_ulps_wakeup_cp -- Clock T_ULPS_WAKEUP global timing parameter will get hit when value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_ULPS_WAKEUP is equal to the time for which the transmitter drives a Mark-1 state prior to a Stop state (LP11) in order to initiate an exit from ULPS.
  • coverpoint clock_rate_range_supported_cp -- Clock rate Range Supported coverpoint will get hit on the basis of lane configuration field DPHY_UI value

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_trail -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_TRAIL
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare_clk_zero -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE_CLK_ZERO
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ulps_wakeup -- Clock rate range and T_ULPS_WAKEUP
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_post -- Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_POST
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_pre -- Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_PRE
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_clock_global_timing_parameter_cg;
   option.per_instance = 1;
  type_option.comment = "D-PHY Cover Group for Clock Global Timing Parameter Coverage";
     t_clk_prepare_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_HS PREPARE global timing parameter";
     bins t_clk_prepare_min_bn = {[svt_mipi_dphy_t_clk_prepare_min : 53*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier]};
     bins t_clk_prepare_typ_bn = {[54*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : 67* svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier]};
     bins t_clk_prepare_max_bn = {[68*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : svt_mipi_dphy_t_clk_prepare_max + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]]};
  }
      t_clk_trail_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_TRAIL"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_TRAIL")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_CLK_TRAIL global timing parameter";
       bins t_clk_trail_min_bn = {[60*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : 80*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier]};
       bins t_clk_trail_typ_bn = {[80 *svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : 95*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier]};
       bins t_clk_trail_max_bn = {[95*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : $]};
   }
      t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_GO"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_GO")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_HS_GO global timing parameter";
       bins t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_min_bn = {[300*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier : (300*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[2])]};
       bins t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_typ_bn = {[(301*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[2]) : (800*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[2])]};
       bins t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_max_bn = {[(801*svt_mipi_dphy_multiplier + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[2]) : $]};
  }
      t_ulps_wakeup_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_ULPS_WAKEUP"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_ULPS_WAKEUP")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_ULPS_WAKEUP global timing parameter";
    bins t_ulps_wakeup_min_bn = {[(1000000* 1) : (1000000* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2])]};
    bins t_ulps_wakeup_typ_bn = {[(1000001* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2]) : (2000000* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2])]};
    bins t_ulps_wakeup_max_bn = {[(2000001* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2]) : $]};
  }
   t_clock_post_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_CLK_POST"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_CLK_POST")) {
    option.weight =1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_CLK_POST global timing parameter";
    bins t_clock_post_min_bin = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[52] : (60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[52] + t_clock_post_40_percent]};
    bins t_clock_post_typ_bin = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[52] + t_clock_post_41_percent : (60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[52] + t_clock_post_70_percent]};
    bins t_clock_post_max_bin = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[52] + t_clock_post_71_percent : $]};
  }
       t_clock_pre_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_CLK_PRE"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_CLK_PRE")) {
    option.weight =1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock T_CLK_PRE global timing parameter";
    bins t_clock_pre_min_bin = {[(8 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) : (8 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) + t_clock_pre_40_percent]};
    bins t_clock_pre_typ_bin = {[(8 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) + t_clock_pre_41_percent : (8 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) + t_clock_pre_70_percent]};
    bins t_clock_pre_max_bin = {[(8 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) + t_clock_pre_71_percent : $]};
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_cp:coverpoint clock_period_value {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock period range supported";
     bins clock_rate_range_80Mbps_300Mbps = {[80 : 300]};
     bins clock_rate_range_300Mbps_1Gbps = {[301 : 1000]};
     bins clock_rate_range_1Gbps_1_5Gbps = {[1001 : 1500]};
     bins clock_rate_range_1_5Gbps_2_5Gbps = {[1501 : 2500]};
     bins clock_rate_range_2_5Gbps_4_5Gbps = {[2501 : 4600]};// Max value 4600 is taken instead of 4500 Mbps : When we convert
                                                              // DPHY_UI value 0.22 (i.e 1 / 4.5 Gbps) to Mbps then it will become
                                                              // 4545 Mbps
     ignore_bins ignore_clock_rate_range_1_5Gbps_2_5Gbps = {[1501 : 2500]} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12);
     ignore_bins ignore_clock_rate_range_2_5Gbps_4_5Gbps = {[2501 : 4600]} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_20);
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_clk_prepare_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE";
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_trail: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_clk_trail_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_CLK_TRAIL";
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare_clk_zero: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE_CLK_ZERO";
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ulps_wakeup: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_ulps_wakeup_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_ULPS_WAKEUP";
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_post: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_clock_post_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_POST";
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_pre: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_clock_pre_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_PRE";
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_clock_lane_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_clock_lane_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Physical layer cover point:
  • coverpoint clock_lane_hs_normal_seq_cp -- Clock lane HS normal sequence(state machine sequence)
  • coverpoint clock_lane_ulps_normal_seq_cp -- Clock lane ULPS normal sequence(state machine sequence)
  • coverpoint clock_behaviour_cp -- Clock behaviour:{Non-continuous, continuous}
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_clock_lane_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI D-PHY Clock Lane Cover Group for Physical layer Coverage";
      clock_lane_hs_normal_seq_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock lane HS normal sequence(state machine sequence)";
     bins clock_hs_normal_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_RQST =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_PRPR =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_GO =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_1 =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_0 =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_HS_1
                                 );
  }
      clock_lane_ulps_normal_seq_cp:coverpoint clock_lane_state {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock lane ULPS normal sequence(state machine sequence)";
    bins clock_ulps_normal_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP =>
                                  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::RX_ULPS_RQST =>
                                  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::RX_ULPS =>
                                  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::RX_ULPS_EXIT =>
                                  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_monitor_common::TX_STOP
                                  );
  }
      clock_behaviour_cp : coverpoint clock_type
  {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Clock Behaviour {Continuous, Non-continuous}" ;
    bins continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS};
    bins non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS};
    ignore_bins ignore_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
    ignore_bins ignore_non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_data_global_timing_parameter_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_data_global_timing_parameter_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for Data Global Timing Parameter Coverage.
  • coverpoint t_hs_prepare_cp -- Data T_HS_PREPARE global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE is equal to the time that the transmitter drives the Data Lane LP-00 Line state immediately before the HS-0 Line state starting the HS transmission.
  • coverpoint t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_cp -- Data T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO is equal to the time THS-PREPARE + time that the transmitter drives the HS-0 state prior to transmitting the Sync sequence.
  • coverpoint t_hs_trail_cp -- Data T_HS_TRAIL global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_TRAIL is equal to the time the transmitter drives the flipped differential state after last payload data bit of a HS transmission burst i.e T hs_trail_value
  • coverpoint t_int_slave_cp -- Data T_INIT_SLAVE global timing parameter will get hit if the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_INIT is equal to the time taken by the master to drive Stop state (LP11) for a period greater than T_init time i.e initialization time.
  • coverpoint t_lpx_cp -- Data T_LPX global timing parameter will get hit when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_LP_REQUEST is equal to ULPS request time, where ULPS request time is equal to T LPX.
  • coverpoint t_ta_get_ta_sure_cp -- Data T_TA_GET_TA_SURE global timing parameter will get hit when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_TA_WAIT is equal to Ta_wait_time which in turn equal to Ta_sure_time according to the specification. This coverpoint will be covered based on the value of Ta_sure_time as defined in timing file.
  • coverpoint t_wake_up_cp -- Data T_WAKEUP global timing parameter will get hit when value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_WAKEUP is equal to the time for which the transmitter drives a Mark-1 state prior to a Stop state (LP11) in order to initiate an exit from Escape state
  • coverpoint clock_rate_range_supported_cp -- Clock rate Range Supported coverpoint will get hit on the basis of lane configuration field DPHY_UI value

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_prepare -- Clock rate range and T_HS_PREPARE
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_prepare_hs_zero -- Clock rate range and T_HS_PREPARE_HS_ZERO
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_trail -- Clock rate range and T_HS_TRAIL
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_int_slave -- Clock rate range and T_INIT_SLAVE
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_lpx -- Clock rate range and T_Lpx
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ta_get_ta_sure -- Clock rate range and T_TA_GET_TA_SURE
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_wake_up_cp -- Clock rate range and T_WAKE_UP
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_exit -- Clock rate range and T_HS_EXIT
  • cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ta_go -- Clock rate range and T_TA_GO
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_data_global_timing_parameter_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  type_option.comment = "D-PHY Cover Group for Data Global Timing Parameter Coverage";
      t_hs_prepare_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_PREPARE global timing parameter";
       bins t_hs_prepare_min_bn = {[(40 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] : (40 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_prepare_40_percent]};
       bins t_hs_prepare_typ_bn = {[(40 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_prepare_41_percent : (40 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_prepare_70_percent]};
       bins t_hs_prepare_max_bn = {[(40 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_prepare_71_percent : $]};
  }
      t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO global timing parameter";
       bins t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_min_bn = {[(145 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[10] : (145 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[10] + t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_40_percent]};
       bins t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_typ_bn = {[(145 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[10] + t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_41_percent : (145 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[10] + t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_70_percent]};
       bins t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_max_bn = {[(145 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[10] + t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_71_percent : $]};
  }
      t_hs_trail_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_TRAIL"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_TRAIL")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_TRAIL global timing parameter";
       bins t_hs_trail_min_bn = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] : (60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_trail_40_percent]};
       bins t_hs_trail_typ_bn = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_trail_41_percent : (60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_trail_70_percent]};
       bins t_hs_trail_max_bn = {[(60 * 1) + svt_mipi_dphy_ui[4] + t_hs_trail_71_percent : $]};
  }
      t_int_slave_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_INIT"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_INIT")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_INIT_SLAVE global timing parameter";
     bins t_int_slave_min_bn = {[(100_000* 1) : (120_000* 1)]};
     bins t_int_slave_typ_bn = {[(120_001* 1) : (180_000* 1)]};
     bins t_int_slave_max_bn = {[(180_001* 1) : $]};
  }
      t_lpx_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_REQUEST"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_REQUEST")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_LPX global timing parameter";
     bins t_lpx_min_bn = {[50* 1 : 70* 1]};
     bins t_lpx_typ_bn = {[70* 1 : 85* 1]};
     bins t_lpx_max_bn = {[85* 1 : $]};
  }
      t_ta_get_ta_sure_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_TA_WAIT"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_TA_WAIT")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_TA_GET_TA_SURE global timing parameter";

  }
      t_wake_up_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_WAKEUP"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_WAKEUP")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_WAKEUP global timing parameter";
     bins t_wake_up_min_bn = {[(1000000* 1) : (1000000* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2])]};
     bins t_wake_up_typ_bn = {[(1000001* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2]) : (2000000* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2])]};
     bins t_wake_up_max_bn = {[(2000001* 1 + svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[2]) : $]};
  }
   t_hs_exit_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_STOP"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_STOP")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_EXIT global timing parameter";
     bins t_hs_exit_min_bn = {[(100* 1) : (1000* 1)]};
     bins t_hs_exit_typ_bn = {[(1001* 1): (2000* 1)]};
     bins t_hs_exit_max_bn = {[(2001* 1) : $]};
  }
   t_ta_go_cp:coverpoint lane_cfg_data_inst.t_ta_go {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "T_TA_GO global timing parameter";
     bins t_ta_go_bn = {svt_mipi_dphy_tlpx[4]};
  }
      clock_rate_range_supported_cp:coverpoint clock_period_value {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Clock period range supported";
     bins clock_rate_range_80Mbps_300Mbps = {[80 : 300]};
     bins clock_rate_range_300Mbps_1Gbps = {[301 : 1000]};
     bins clock_rate_range_1Gbps_1_5Gbps = {[1001 : 1500]};
     bins clock_rate_range_1_5Gbps_2_5Gbps = {[1501 : 2500]};
     bins clock_rate_range_2_5Gbps_4_5Gbps = {[2501 : 4600]};// Max value 4600 is taken instead of 4500 Mbps : When we convert
                                                              // DPHY_UI value 0.22 (i.e 1 / 4.5 Gbps) to Mbps then it will become
                                                              // 4545 Mbps
     ignore_bins ignore_clock_rate_range_1_5Gbps_2_5Gbps = {[1501 : 2500]} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12);
     ignore_bins ignore_clock_rate_range_2_5Gbps_4_5Gbps = {[2501 : 4600]} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_20);
  }

    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_Lpx";

        clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ta_get_ta_sure: cross clock_rate_range_supported_cp, t_ta_get_ta_sure_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between Clock rate range and T_TA_GET_TA_SURE";

                                    svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_RQST_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                    svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_PRPR_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                    svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_ZERO_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                    svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE[*num_lanes]
                                   );
     bins lp11_during_pkt_hs_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                   svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_RQST_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                   svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_PRPR_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                   svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_HS_ZERO_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                   svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_PAYLOAD_STATE[*num_lanes] =>
                                   svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE[*num_lanes]
                                   );
   }
      lp11_during_escape_mode_cp:coverpoint data_lane_state {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "LP11 during Escape Mode:{During Escape Mode Entry, During Entry Command, During ULPS}";
    bins lp11_during_entry_mode_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_YIELD_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_GO_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE),
                                       (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_YIELD_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE),
                                       (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_YIELD_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE),
                                       (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                        svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE
                                       );
     bins lp11_during_entry_cmd_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_YIELD_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_RQST_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_GO_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_CMD_STATE =>
                                      svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE
                                      );
     bins lp11_during_ulps_seq = (svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_RQST_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_LP_YIELD_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_RQST_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_GO_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ESC_CMD_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_ULPS_STATE =>
                                 svt_mipi_dphy_monitor_common::RX_STOP_STATE);
   }
endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dphy_hs_idle_timing_parameter_cg

svt_mipi_dphy_hs_idle_timing_parameter_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for HS Idle Global Timing Parameter Coverage.
  • coverpoint t_hs_idle_post_cp -- Data T_HS_IDLE_POST global timing parameter will be covered when the transmitter drives the Data Lane HS-0 Line state immediately before detects no clock activity on clock lane
  • coverpoint t_hs_idle_clkhs0_cp -- Data T_HS_IDLE_CLKHS0 global timing parameter will be covered when the transmitter starts driving the clock lane after no activity for t_clk_miss period
covergroup svt_mipi_dphy_hs_idle_timing_parameter_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  type_option.comment = "D-PHY Cover Group for HS Idle Global Timing Parameter Coverage";
      t_hs_idle_post_cp:coverpoint data_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_IDLE_POST"] iff(data_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_IDLE_POST")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_IDLE_POST global timing parameter";
     bins t_hs_idle_post_min_typ_bn = {[( 8 * 8 * svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]) : (256 * svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1])]};
     bins t_hs_idle_post_typ_max_bn = {[(257 * svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1]): (512 *svt_mipi_dphy_ui[1])]};
  }
      t_hs_idle_clkhs0_cp:coverpoint clock_global_timing_parameter["SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_IDLE_CLKHS0"] iff(clock_global_timing_parameter.exists("SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_IDLE_CLKHS0")) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Data T_HS_IDLE_CLKHS0 global timing parameter";
     bins t_hs_idle_clkhs0_min_bin = {[60 * 1 : t_hs_idle_clk_40_percent]};
    bins t_hs_idle_clkhs0_typ_bin = {[t_hs_idle_clk_41_percent : t_hs_idle_clk_70_percent]};
    bins t_hs_idle_clkhs0_max_bin = {[t_hs_idle_clk_71_percent : 500 * 1]};
  }
 endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_collect_transactions_per_lane_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_collect_transactions_per_lane_cg covergroup definition.
DSI-DPHY coverage per lane based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint num_bytes_lane1_cp -- Number of bytes per packet on lane 1:{1: 65536}
  • coverpoint num_bytes_lane1_cp -- Number of bytes per packet on lane 2:{1: 65536}
  • coverpoint num_bytes_lane3_cp -- Number of bytes per packet on lane 3:{1: 65536}
  • coverpoint num_bytes_lane4_cp -- Number of bytes per packet on lane 4:{1: 65536}
  • coverpoint packet_size_cp -- Total no of bytes in a single packet {1: 65536}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross packet_size_vs_last_byte_lane_number -- packet_size, last_byte_lane_number
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_collect_transactions_per_lane_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI-DPHY Collect Transactions on per lane basis Cover Group";
      num_bytes_lane1_cp: coverpoint num_bytes_lane1 {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of bytes per packet on lane 1";
    bins num_bytes_1B = {1};
    bins num_bytes_2B_1K = {[2:1024]};
    bins num_bytes_1K_4K = {[1025:4096]};
    bins num_bytes_4K_8K = {[4097:8192]};
    bins num_bytes_8K_16K = {[8193:16384]};
    bins num_bytes_16K_32K = {[16385:32768]};
    bins num_bytes_32K_64K = {[32769:65536]};
  }
      num_bytes_lane2_cp: coverpoint num_bytes_lane2 {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of bytes per packet on lane 2";
    bins num_bytes_1B = {1};
    bins num_bytes_2B_1K = {[2:1024]};
    bins num_bytes_1K_4K = {[1025:4096]};
    bins num_bytes_4K_8K = {[4097:8192]};
    bins num_bytes_8K_16K = {[8193:16384]};
    bins num_bytes_16K_32K = {[16385:32768]};
  }
      num_bytes_lane3_cp: coverpoint num_bytes_lane3 {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of bytes per packet on lane 3";
    bins num_bytes_1B = {1};
    bins num_bytes_2B_1K = {[2:1024]};
    bins num_bytes_1K_4K = {[1025:4096]};
    bins num_bytes_4K_8K = {[4097:8192]};
    bins num_bytes_8K_16K = {[8193:16384]};
    bins num_bytes_16K_32K = {[16385:32768]};
  }
      num_bytes_lane4_cp: coverpoint num_bytes_lane4 {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of bytes per packet on lane 4";
    bins num_bytes_1B = {1};
    bins num_bytes_2B_1K = {[2:1024]};
    bins num_bytes_1K_4K = {[1025:4096]};
    bins num_bytes_4K_8K = {[4097:8192]};
    bins num_bytes_8K_16K = {[8193:16384]};
  }
      packet_size_cp: coverpoint packet_size {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Total Number of bytes in packet";
    bins packet_size_1B = {1};
    bins packet_size_2B_1K = {[2:1024]};
    bins packet_size_1K_4K = {[1025:4096]};
    bins packet_size_4K_8K = {[4097:8192]};
    bins packet_size_8K_16K = {[8193:16384]};
    bins packet_size_16K_32K = {[16385:32768]};
    bins packet_size_32K_64K = {[32769:65536]};
  }
      last_byte_lane_number_cp: coverpoint last_lane_packet_length_modulo {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Last lane byte coverage";
    bins last_lane_1_cp = { 1 };
    bins last_lane_2_cp = { 2 };
    bins last_lane_3_cp = { 3 };
    bins last_lane_4_cp = { 4 };
    ignore_bins num_lane_1 = {2,3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==1);
    ignore_bins num_lane_2 = {3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==2);
    ignore_bins num_lane_3 = {4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==3);
  }
      num_lanes_cp:coverpoint dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment="Number of data lanes";
    bins num_lanes_1 = {1};
    bins num_lanes_2 = {2};
    bins num_lanes_3 = {3};
    bins num_lanes_4 = {4};
  }
      transmission_mode_cp:coverpoint lane_data_inst.transmission_mode {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Transmission Mode HS coverage";
    bins transmission_mode_hs_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS};
  }
      packet_size_vs_last_byte_lane_number :cross packet_size_cp, last_byte_lane_number_cp{
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet size and last byte of a packet occurence on a specific lane Cross Coverage";
  }
        trans_mode_vs_num_lanes_vs_byte_count_per_lane :cross transmission_mode_cp, num_lanes_cp, num_bytes_lane1_cp,num_bytes_lane2_cp, num_bytes_lane3_cp, num_bytes_lane4_cp{
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Cross coverage between HS transmission mode, num_lanes and bytes count per lane";
  }
 endgroup

DSI interleaving scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint vc_id_cp -- VC ID value:{0,1,2,3}
  • coverpoint interleave_2_vc_cp -- Virtual channels interleaving 2 VCs: {0011, 0101, 0110, 1001, 1010, 1100}
  • coverpoint interleave_3_vc_cp -- Virtual channels interleaving 3 VCs: {0111, 1011, 1101, 1110}
  • coverpoint interleave_4_vc_cp -- Virtual channels interleaving 4 VCs: {1111}
  • coverpoint sync_packet_data_type_cp -- Synchronization Packet Data type:{0x01,0x11,0x21,0x31}
  • coverpoint cmd_packet_data_type_cp -- Command Packet Data type:{0x02,0x12,0x22,0x32}
  • coverpoint gen_short_write_data_type_cp -- Generic Short Write Data type:{0x03,0x13,0x23}
  • coverpoint dcs_short_write_data_type_cp -- DCS Short Write Data type:{0x05,0x15}
  • coverpoint read_data_type_cp -- Read Data type:{0x04,0x06,0x14,0x24,0x37}
  • coverpoint long_cmd_packet_cp -- Long Command Data type:{0x09,0x0A,0x19,0x29,0x39}
  • coverpoint long_video_data_type_cp -- Long Video Data Type:{0x0E,0X1E,0X2E,0X3E}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross interleave_4_vc_vs_read_packet -- Virtual channels interleaving 4 VCs, Read Data type
  • cross interleave_4_vc_vs_dcs_short_packet -- Virtual channels interleaving 4 VCs, Short write packets

        sync_packet_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {

      read_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.bta_enable == 1'b1){

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_lane_management_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_lane_management_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Packet based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint num_lanes_cp -- Number of lanes:{1 to`num_of_lanes}
  • coverpoint packet_length_modulo_cp -- Num of lanes-packet length modulo:{N, N+1, N+2 to `num_of_lanes-1}}
  • coverpoint multiple_packet_support_cp -- Number of multiple packets:{2,3,4:more than 4 }
  • coverpoint eotp_support_cp -- EoTp support:{enabled , disabled}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross num_lanes_vs_packet_length_modulo_vs_EoTp_Support -- Number of lanes , Packet length modulo, EoTp Support
  • cross num_lanes_vs_multiple_packet_support_vs_EoTp_Support -- Number of lanes , Multiple packet support, EoTp Support
  • cross num_lanes_vs_Packet_length_modulo_vs_multiple_packet_support -- Number of lanes , Packet length modulo, Multiple packet support

covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_lane_management_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI management Cover Group";
      num_lanes_cp:coverpoint local_num_lanes {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment="Number of data lanes";
    bins num_lanes_0 = {1};
    bins num_lanes_1 = {2};
    bins num_lanes_2 = {3};
    bins num_lanes_3 = {4};
  }
     num_total_packets_cp: coverpoint num_total_packets {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Number of total packets in multiple packet coverage";
    bins num_total_packets_0 = {2};
    bins num_total_packets_1 = {3};
    bins num_total_packets_2 = {[4:$]};
  }
       packet_length_modulo_cp: coverpoint packet_length_modulo {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Total Packet length coverage";
    bins packet_length_0 = { 0 };
    bins packet_length_1 = { 1 };
    bins packet_length_2 = { 2 };
    bins packet_length_3 = { 3 };
    bins packet_length_4 = { 4 };
    bins packet_length_5 = { 5 };
    bins packet_length_6 = { 6 };
    bins packet_length_7 = { 7 };
    bins packet_length_8 = { 8 };
    bins packet_length_9 = { 9 };
    bins packet_length_10 = { 10 };
    bins packet_length_11 = { 11 };
  }
     eotp_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.eotp_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.eotp_recp_enable} {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "EoTp Support coverage";
    bins EoTp_support_00 = {2'b00};
    wildcard bins EoTp_support_x1 = {2'bx1} iff (dsi_cfg_data_inst.device_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_DEVICE);
    wildcard bins EoTp_support_1x = {2'b1x} iff (dsi_cfg_data_inst.device_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_HOST);
  }
     num_lanes_vs_packet_length_modulo_vs_EoTp_Support:cross num_lanes_cp, packet_length_modulo_cp, eotp_support_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of lanes , Packet length modulo, EoTp Support Cross Coverage";
  }
     num_lanes_vs_multiple_packet_support_vs_EoTp_Support:cross num_lanes_cp, num_total_packets_cp, eotp_support_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of lanes ,Multiple packet support, EoTp Support Cross Coverage";
  }
     num_lanes_vs_Packet_length_modulo_vs_multiple_packet_support:cross num_lanes_cp, packet_length_modulo_cp, num_total_packets_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Number of lanes , Packet length modulo, Multiple packet support Cross Coverage";
  }
 endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_long_packet_command_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_long_packet_command_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Packet based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint long_cmd_packet_cp -- Long Command Data type:{0x09,0x19,0x29,0x39}
  • coverpoint transmission_mode_cp -- Packet Transmission Mode:{HS,LP}
  • coverpoint crc_support_cp -- CRC support:{Transmit on/off, Receive on/off }
  • coverpoint ecc_support_cp -- ECC support:{Transmit on/off, Receive on/off}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_long_cmd_packet -- Transmission Mode, Long Command Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_long_cmd_packet -- ECC Support, Long Command Data type
  • cross crc_support_vs_long_cmd_packet -- CRC Support, Long Command Data type
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_long_packet_command_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Long Packet Command Cover Group for Packet based scenerios Coverage";
      long_cmd_packet_cp: coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="Long_command_packet data type";
    bins data_type_null_packet_bn = {8'h09};
    bins data_type_blanking_packet_bn = {8'h19};
    bins data_type_gen_long_write_bn = {8'h29};
    bins data_type_dcs_long_write_bn = {8'h39};
  }
        transmission_mode_cp: coverpoint dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Transmission Mode [HS,LP] coverage";
    bins transmission_mode_hs_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::HS};
    bins transmission_mode_lp_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT};
  }
       crc_support_cp: coverpoint {dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_recp_enable} iff(dsi_data_inst.packet_kind == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LONG) {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "CRC Support coverage";
  }
      ecc_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_recp_enable} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support coverage";
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_long_cmd_packet: cross transmission_mode_cp,long_cmd_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Transmission Mode and Long Command Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      ecc_support_vs_long_cmd_packet: cross ecc_support_cp,long_cmd_packet_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and Long Command Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      crc_support_vs_long_cmd_packet: cross crc_support_cp,long_cmd_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "CRC Support and Long Command Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_long_packet_data_stream_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_memory_packet_data_stream_cg covergroup definition.
DSI memory_data Stream Sequence scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint memory_generic_frame_size_cp -- Memory generic Frame Size:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint memory_data_line_size_cp -- memory data Line Size:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint memory_data_stream_gen_packet_cp -- Memory Data Stream with Genric long Packet
  • coverpoint memory_data_stream_dcs_packet_cp -- Memory Data Stream with DCS long Packet
  • coverpoint memory_dcs_frame_size_cp -- memory DCS Frame Size:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint clock_behaviour_cp -- Clock behaviour:{Non-continuous, continuous}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross clock_behaviour_vs_memory_data_stream_dcs_packet -- Clock behaviour, Memory Data Stream DCS Packet
  • cross clock_behaviour_vs_memory_data_stream_gen_packet -- Clock behaviour, Memory Data Stream Generic Packet
  • cross memory_data_line_size_vs_memory_data_stream_dcs_packet -- Memory data Line Size, Memory Data Stream DCS Packet
  • cross memory_data_line_size_vs_memory_data_stream_gen_packet -- Memory data Line Size, Memory Data Stream Genric Packet
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_long_packet_data_stream_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI memory Packet Data Stream Cover Group for memory_data Stream Sequence scenerios Coverage";
      memory_generic_frame_size_cp:coverpoint mem_gen_frame_size_cov {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory data Frame Size:{Small, Medium, Large}";
    bins memory_data_frame_size_small = {[1:100]};
    bins memory_data_frame_size_medium = {[101:500]};
    bins memory_data_frame_size_large = {[501:$]};
  }
         memory_data_line_size_cp:coverpoint mem_line_size_cov {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Memory data line Size:{Small, Medium, Large}";
    bins memory_data_line_size_small = {[1:100]};
    bins memory_data_line_size_medium = {[101:500]};
    bins memory_data_line_size_large = {[501:$]};
  }
      memory_data_stream_gen_packet_cp:coverpoint long_stream_gen_packet {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Memory Data Stream with Genric long Packet";
    bins memory_data_stream_gen_packet = {1};
  }
      memory_data_stream_dcs_packet_cp:coverpoint long_stream_dcs_packet {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Memory Data Stream with DCS long Packet";
    bins memory_data_stream_dcs_packet = {1};
  }
      memory_dcs_frame_size_cp:coverpoint mem_dcs_frame_size_cov {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory data Frame Size:{Small, Medium, Large}";
    bins memory_data_frame_size_small = {[1:100]};
    bins memory_data_frame_size_medium = {[101:500]};
    bins memory_data_frame_size_large = {[501:$]};
  }
     clock_behaviour_cp : coverpoint clock_type
  {
    type_option.comment = "Clock Behaviour {Continuous, Non-continuous}" ;
    option.weight = 0;
    bins continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS};
    bins non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS};
    ignore_bins ignore_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
    ignore_bins ignore_non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
  }
      clock_behaviour_vs_memory_data_stream_dcs_packet: cross memory_data_stream_dcs_packet_cp, clock_behaviour_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory data stream of DCS Packet and Clock Behaviour";
  }
        clock_behaviour_vs_memory_data_stream_gen_packet: cross memory_data_stream_gen_packet_cp, clock_behaviour_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory data stream of Generic packet and Clock Behaviour";
  }
      memory_data_line_size_vs_memory_data_stream_dcs_packet:cross memory_data_line_size_cp, memory_data_stream_dcs_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory Data line Size and DCS Packet cross coverage";
  }
      memory_data_line_size_vs_memory_data_stream_gen_packet:cross memory_data_line_size_cp, memory_data_stream_gen_packet_cp{
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Memory Data line Size and Generic Packet cross coverage";
  }
 endgroup

    bins loosely_packed_pixel_666_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666};
    bins loosely_packed_pixel_20_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_24_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_16_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_101010_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_30BITS_RGB_101010};
    bins packed_pixel_121212_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_36BITS_RGB_121212};
    bins packed_pixel_420_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420};

               ecc_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_recp_enable} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support Coverage";
    bins ecc_enable = {2'b11};
    bins ecc_disable = {2'b00};
  }
      crc_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_recp_enable} iff(dsi_data_inst.packet_kind == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LONG){
    option.weight = 0;

    bins crc_disable = {2'b00};
  }
      ecc_support_vs_long_video_packet:cross ecc_support_cp, long_video_packet_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC support and Long Video Packets Cross Coverage";
   }
      crc_support_vs_long_video_packet:cross crc_support_cp, long_video_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "CRC support and Long Video Packets Cross Coverage";
  }
 endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_low_level_protocol_error_cg

* svt_mipi_dsi_low_level_protocol_error_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Error Scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint hs_timeout_error_cp -- High speed transmission timeout error{Min, Typ, Max}
  • coverpoint single_bit_sot_error_cp -- Lane Exception Single bit SOT error Coverage
  • coverpoint multi_bit_sot_error_cp -- Lane Exception Multi bit SOT error Coverage
  • coverpoint eot_sync_error_cp -- Lane Exception EOT sync error Coverage
  • coverpoint esc_mode_ent_cmd_error_cp -- Lane Exception ESC mode entry command error Coverage
  • coverpoint lp_trans_sync_error_cp -- Lane Exception LP transmission sync error Coverage
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_low_level_protocol_error_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Low Level Protocol Error Cover Group for Error Scenerios Coverage";
       hs_timeout_error_cp:coverpoint lane_cfg_data_inst.hs_tx_to_counter{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins hs_timeout_error_min = {[0:10000]};
    bins hs_timeout_error_typ = {[10000:60000]};
    bins hs_timeout_error_max = {[60000:$]};
  }
      single_bit_sot_error_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.lane_transaction_error iff(this.lane_exception != null) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception Single bit SOT error Coverage";
    bins single_bit_sot_error_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_SOT_HS} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
      err_sot_hs_value_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.err_sot_hs_value iff(this.lane_exception != null && lane_exception.lane_transaction_error == svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_SOT_HS) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception Single bit SOT error coverage on particular bit";
    bins single_bit_sot_error_0th_bit = {8'b00000001} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_1st_bit = {8'b00000010} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_2nd_bit = {8'b00000100} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_3rd_bit = {8'b00001000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_4th_bit = {8'b00010000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_5th_bit = {8'b00100000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_6th_bit = {8'b01000000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins single_bit_sot_error_7th_bit = {8'b10000000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
      err_sot_sync_hs_value_cp: coverpoint err_sot_sync_hs_value iff(this.lane_exception != null && lane_exception.lane_transaction_error == svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception Multi bit SOT error Coverage on few combinations of two bits";
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_0th_and_1st_bit = {8'b00000011} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_1st_and_2nd_bit = {8'b00000110} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_2nd_and_3rd_bit = {8'b00001100} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_3rd_and_4th_bit = {8'b00011000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_4th_and_5th_bit = {8'b00110000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_5th_and_6th_bit = {8'b01100000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_6th_and_7th_bit = {8'b11000000} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
       }
       multi_bit_sot_error_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.lane_transaction_error iff(this.lane_exception != null) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception Multi bit SOT error Coverage";
    bins multi_bit_sot_error_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
      eot_sync_error_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.lane_transaction_error iff(this.lane_exception != null) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception EOT sync error Coverage";
    bins eot_sync_error_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_EOT_SYNC} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
      esc_mode_ent_cmd_error_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.lane_transaction_error iff(this.lane_exception != null) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception ESC mode entry command error Coverage";
    bins esc_mode_ent_cmd_error_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_ESC_MODE_ENTRY_CMD} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode != svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
      lp_trans_sync_error_cp: coverpoint lane_exception.lane_transaction_error iff(this.lane_exception != null) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Lane Exception LP transmission sync error Coverage";
    bins lp_trans_sync_error_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception::ERR_LP_TRANSMISSION_SYNC} iff(lane_data_inst.transmission_mode != svt_mipi_lane_transaction::HS);
  }
 endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_packet_based_protocol_error_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_packet_based_protocol_error_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Error Scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint single_bit_ecc_error_cp -- Single bit ECC error:{Error bit position=1,………Error bit position=24}
  • coverpoint multi_bit_ecc_error_cp -- Multie bit ECCerror:{Error bit position=1,………Error bit position=24}
  • coverpoint crc_error_cp -- CRC error:{Error bit position=1 to Error bit position=16}
  • coverpoint crc_value_ffff_not_0_word_count_cp -- CRC=4'FFFF for Word Count>0
  • coverpoint invalid_transmission_length_cp -- Invalid transmission length:{Word count > Actual length,Word count < Actual length}
  • coverpoint invalid_vc_id_cp -- Invalid VC ID type error
  • coverpoint host_trans_eotp_device_not_support_cp -- Host sends EoTp when device don’t support it
  • coverpoint transmission_mode_cp -- Packet Transmission Mode:{HS,LP}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_single_bit_ecc_error -- Packet Transmission mode, Single bit ECC error
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_multi_bit_ecc_error -- Packet Transmission mode, Multie bit ECCerror
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_crc_error -- Packet Transmission mode, CRC error
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_invalid_transmission_length -- Packet Transmission mode, Invalid transmission length
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_packet_based_protocol_error_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Packet Based Protocol Error Cover Group for Error Scenerios Coverage";
      single_bit_ecc_error_cp:coverpoint dsi_exception_data_inst.err_bit_position iff(dsi_exception_data_inst.dsi_packet_error == svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::ERR_ECC_SINGLE_BIT)
  {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Single Bit ECC Error position coverage";
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_0_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0000_0001};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_1_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0000_0010};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_2_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0000_0100};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_3_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0000_1000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_4_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0001_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_5_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0010_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_6_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_0100_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_7_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0000_1000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_8_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0001_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_9_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0010_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_10_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_0100_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_11_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0000_1000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_12_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0001_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_13_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0010_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_14_bn = {24'b0000_0000_0100_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_15_bn = {24'b0000_0000_1000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_16_bn = {24'b0000_0001_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_17_bn = {24'b0000_0010_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_18_bn = {24'b0000_0100_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_19_bn = {24'b0000_1000_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_20_bn = {24'b0001_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_21_bn = {24'b0010_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_22_bn = {24'b0100_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000};
    bins ecc_single_bit_err_position_23_bn = {24'b1000_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000};
  }
      multi_bit_ecc_error_cp:coverpoint dsi_exception_data_inst.dsi_packet_error {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Multi bit ECC Error coverage";
    bins multi_bit_ecc_error_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::ERR_ECC_MULTI_BIT};
  }
      crc_error_cp:coverpoint dsi_exception_data_inst.dsi_packet_error iff(dsi_data_inst.packet_kind == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LONG) {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "CRC Error coverage";
    bins crc_error_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::ERR_CRC};
  }
      crc_value_ffff_not_0_word_count_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.crc_value iff(dsi_data_inst.packet_kind == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LONG){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment="CRC value is 16'hFFFF when Word Count is greater than 0 and CRC is not equal to 16'hFFFF when WC=0";
    bins CRC_FFFF={16'hFFFF} iff(dsi_data_inst.data_word_count > 0);
    bins CRC_NOT_FFFF = {[16'h0000:16'hFFFE]} iff(dsi_data_inst.data_word_count == 0);
  }
      invalid_transmission_length_cp:coverpoint dsi_exception_data_inst.dsi_packet_error {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Invalid transmission length coverage";
    bins invalid_packet_size_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::ERR_PAYLOAD_SIZE};
  }
      invalid_vc_id_cp:coverpoint dsi_exception_data_inst.dsi_packet_error {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Invalid Virtual Channel ID coverage";
    bins invalid_vc_id_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception::ERR_VC_ID};
  }
      host_trans_eotp_device_not_support_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id iff (dsi_cfg_data_inst.eotp_gen_enable == 0) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Host sends EoTp when device does not support it";
    bins host_trans_eotp_device_not_support_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::EOTP};
  }
      transmission_mode_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Transmission Mode [HS,LP] coverage";
    bins transmission_mode_hs_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::HS};
    bins transmission_mode_lp_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT};
  }
      first_lane_trail_word_corrupted_cp:coverpoint trail_byte_error[0] iff (lane_cfg_data_inst.hs_trail_user_defined_bytes== 1) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Trail word corruption on lane 1";
    wildcard bins first_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'b1xx};
    wildcard bins second_trail_word_corrupted_bn= {3'bx1x};
    wildcard bins third_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'bxx1};
  }
      second_lane_trail_word_corrupted_cp:coverpoint trail_byte_error[1] iff (lane_cfg_data_inst.hs_trail_user_defined_bytes== 1) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Trail word corruption on lane 2";
    wildcard bins first_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'b1xx};
    wildcard bins second_trail_word_corrupted_bn= {3'bx1x};
    wildcard bins third_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'bxx1};
  }
      third_lane_trail_word_corrupted_cp:coverpoint trail_byte_error[2] iff (lane_cfg_data_inst.hs_trail_user_defined_bytes== 1) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Trail word corruption on lane 3";
    wildcard bins first_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'b1xx};
    wildcard bins second_trail_word_corrupted_bn= {3'bx1x};
    wildcard bins third_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'bxx1};
  }
      fourth_lane_trail_word_corrupted_cp:coverpoint trail_byte_error[3] iff (lane_cfg_data_inst.hs_trail_user_defined_bytes== 1) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Trail word corruption on lane 4";
    wildcard bins first_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'b1xx};
    wildcard bins second_trail_word_corrupted_bn= {3'bx1x};
    wildcard bins third_trail_word_corrupted_bn = {3'bxx1};
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_single_bit_ecc_error:cross transmission_mode_cp,single_bit_ecc_error_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet Transmission mode and Single bit ECC error Cross Coverage";
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_multi_bit_ecc_error:cross transmission_mode_cp,multi_bit_ecc_error_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet Transmission mode and Multie bit ECC error Cross Coverage";
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_crc_error:cross transmission_mode_cp,crc_error_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet Transmission mode and CRC error Cross Coverage";
  }
        transmission_mode_vs_invalid_transmission_length:cross transmission_mode_cp, invalid_transmission_length_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet Transmission mode and Invalid transmission length Cross Coverage";
  }
    endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Packet based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint transmission_mode_cp -- Packet Transmission Mode:{HS,LP,ULPM,TRIGGER,INITIAL_SKEW,PERIODIC_SKEW}
    • INITIAL_SKEW & PERIODIC_SKEW are applicable for DPHY VERSION 1.2 and higher.
  • coverpoint word_count_cp -- Word count:{0,Small,Medium:Large}
  • coverpoint crc_support_cp -- CRC support:{Transmit on/off, Receive on/off }
  • coverpoint ecc_support_cp -- ECC support:{Transmit on/off, Receive on/off}
  • coverpoint eotp_support_cp -- EoTp support:{Enabled, Disabled}
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Protocol Cover Group for Packet based scenerios/sequences Coverage";
      transmission_mode_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Packet Transmission Mode Coverage. ";
    ignore_bins ignore_INITIAL_SKEW = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::INITIAL_SKEW} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12);
    ignore_bins ignore_PERIODIC_SKEW = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PERIODIC_SKEW} iff(lane_cfg_data_inst.dphy_protocol_version < svt_mipi_lane_configuration::DPHY_VERSION_12);
  }
      word_count_cp: coverpoint dsi_data_inst.data_word_count {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Payload Word Count coverage";
    bins data_word_count_0 = {0};
    bins data_word_count_small = {[1:20]};
    bins data_word_count_medium = {[21:3999]};
    bins data_word_count_large = {[4000:65535]};
  }
      crc_support_cp: coverpoint {dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.crc_recp_enable} iff(dsi_data_inst.packet_kind == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LONG) {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "CRC Support coverage";
    bins crc_enable = {2'b11};
    bins crc_disable = {2'b00};
  }
      packet_spacing_cp: coverpoint packet_spacing {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Packet spacing coverage";
    bins packet_spacing_min = {[1 * 1 : 1000 * 1]};
    bins packet_spacing_typ = {[1001 * 1 : 2000 * 1]};
    bins packet_spacing_max = {[3001 * 1 : $]};
  }
      sot_pattern_in_data_cp: coverpoint sot_pattern_in_data{
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Number of SOT pattern 8'h1D in data words coverage";
    bins sot_pattern_in_data_min = {[1:10]};
    bins sot_pattern_in_data_typ = {[11:20]};
    bins sot_pattern_in_data_max = {[21:$]};
  }
      sot_skew_pattern_in_data_cp: coverpoint sot_skew_sync_pattern_in_data{
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Number of skew sync 16'hFF pattern in data words coverage";
    bins sot_skew_sync_pattern_in_data_min = {[1:10]};
    bins sot_skew_sync_pattern_in_data_typ = {[11:20]};
    bins sot_skew_sync_pattern_in_data_max = {[21:$]};
  }
      extended_sync_pattern_in_data_cp: coverpoint extended_sync_pattern_in_data{
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Number of extended sync 8'hFF pattern in data words coverage";
    bins extended_sync_pattern_in_data_min = {[1:10]};
    bins extended_sync_pattern_in_data_typ = {[11:20]};
    bins extended_sync_pattern_in_data_max = {[21:$]};
  }
      ecc_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_recp_enable} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support coverage";
    bins ecc_enable = {2'b11};
    bins ecc_disable = {2'b00};
  }
      eotp_support_cp: coverpoint {dsi_cfg_data_inst.eotp_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.eotp_recp_enable} {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "EoTp Support coverage";
    bins EoTp_support_00 = {2'b00};
    wildcard bins EoTp_support_x1 = {2'b01} iff (dsi_cfg_data_inst.device_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_DEVICE);
    wildcard bins EoTp_support_1x = {2'b10} iff (dsi_cfg_data_inst.device_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DSI_HOST);
  }
  endgroup

 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_packet_length_modulo_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_packet_length_modulo_cg covergroup definition
DSI packet based scenarios cover point:
  • coverpoint starting_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp
  • coverpoint last_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross start_lane_vs_last_lane_number_cp -- Start_lane_byte_number, last_lane_byte_number
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_protocol_packet_length_modulo_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Protocol Cover Group for Packet length modulo Coverage";
      starting_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp: coverpoint starting_lane_packet_length_modulo {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Starting lane byte coverage";
    bins starting_lane_1_cp = { 1 };
    bins starting_lane_2_cp = { 2 };
    bins starting_lane_3_cp = { 3 };
    bins starting_lane_4_cp = { 4 };
    ignore_bins num_lane_1 = {2,3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==1);
    ignore_bins num_lane_2 = {3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==2);
    ignore_bins num_lane_3 = {4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==3);
   }
     last_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp: coverpoint last_lane_packet_length_modulo {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Last lane byte coverage";
    bins last_lane_1_cp = { 1 };
    bins last_lane_2_cp = { 2 };
    bins last_lane_3_cp = { 3 };
    bins last_lane_4_cp = { 4 };
    ignore_bins num_lane_1 = {2,3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==1);
    ignore_bins num_lane_2 = {3,4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==2);
    ignore_bins num_lane_3 = {4} iff(dsi_cfg_data_inst.num_lanes ==3);
  }
      start_lane_vs_last_lane_number_cp: cross starting_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp, last_lane_packet_length_modulo_cp {
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "Starting lane vs Last lane Cross Coverage";
  }
  endgroup
