 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_response_data_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_response_data_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Response Packet Generation cover point:
  • coverpoint tearing_effect_cp -- Tearing Effect [Back to Back Trigger]
  • coverpoint forward_non_read_id_resp_ack_with_err_cp -- Forward Packet: NON_READ -> Response Packet: ACK_WITH_ERROR
  • coverpoint forward_non_read_id_resp_trigger_cp -- Forward Packet: NON_READ -> Response Packet: TRIGGER
  • coverpoint gen_read0_id_gen_long_read_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: GEN_READ0 -> Response Packet: GEN_LONG_READ_RESP
  • coverpoint gen_read1_id_gen_short_read1_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: GEN_READ1 -> Response Packet: GEN_SHORT_READ1_RESP
  • coverpoint gen_read2_id_gen_short_read2_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: GEN_READ2 -> Response Packet: GEN_SHORT_READ2_RESP
  • coverpoint dcs_read0_id_dcs_long_read_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: DCS_READ0 -> Response Packet: DCS_LONG_READ_RESP
  • coverpoint dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read1_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: DCS_READ0 -> Response Packet: DCS_SHORT_READ1_RESP
  • coverpoint dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read2_resp_cp -- Forward Packet: DCS_READ0 -> Response Packet: DCS_SHORT_READ2_RESP
  • coverpoint forward_read_id_resp_read_cp -- Forward Packet: READ -> Response Packet: READ RESPONSE and ACK_WITH_ERROR in interleave mode
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_response_data_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Response Packet Coverage";
      tearing_effect_cp: coverpoint data_id {
    option.weight = 1;
    bins tearing_effect_seq = (DCS_LONG_WRITE => TRIGGER => TRIGGER),
                              (DCS_WRITE1 => TRIGGER => TRIGGER);
  }
      forward_non_read_id_resp_ack_with_err_cp: coverpoint data_id {
    option.weight = 1;
    bins forward_non_read_id_resp_ack_with_err_seq = (GEN_WRITE0 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (GEN_WRITE1 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (GEN_WRITE2 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (DCS_WRITE0 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (DCS_WRITE1 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (GEN_LONG_WRITE => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (DCS_LONG_WRITE => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (VSYNC_START => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (VSYNC_END => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (HSYNC_START => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (HSYNC_END => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (COLOR_MODE_OFF => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (COLOR_MODE_ON => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (SHUT_DOWN => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (TURN_ON => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (NULL_PACKET => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (BLANKING_PACKET => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (PACKED_PIXEL_565 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (PACKED_PIXEL_666 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                     (PACKED_PIXEL_888 => ACK_WITH_ERR);
  }
      forward_non_read_id_resp_trigger_cp: coverpoint data_id {
    bins forward_non_read_id_resp_trigger_seq = (GEN_WRITE0 => TRIGGER),
                                                (GEN_WRITE1 => TRIGGER),
                                                (GEN_WRITE2 => TRIGGER),
                                                (DCS_WRITE0 => TRIGGER),
                                                (DCS_WRITE1 => TRIGGER),
                                                (GEN_LONG_WRITE => TRIGGER),
                                                (DCS_LONG_WRITE => TRIGGER),
                                                (VSYNC_START => TRIGGER),
                                                (VSYNC_END => TRIGGER),
                                                (HSYNC_START => TRIGGER),
                                                (HSYNC_END => TRIGGER),
                                                (COLOR_MODE_OFF => TRIGGER),
                                                (COLOR_MODE_ON => TRIGGER),
                                                (SHUT_DOWN => TRIGGER),
                                                (TURN_ON => TRIGGER),
                                                (SET_MAX_RTN_PKT_SIZE => TRIGGER),
                                                (NULL_PACKET => TRIGGER),
                                                (BLANKING_PACKET => TRIGGER),
                                                (PACKED_PIXEL_565 => TRIGGER),
                                                (PACKED_PIXEL_666 => TRIGGER),
                                                (LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666 => TRIGGER),
                                                (PACKED_PIXEL_888 => TRIGGER);
  }
      gen_read0_id_gen_long_read_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins gen_read0_id_gen_long_read_resp_seq = (GEN_READ0 => GEN_LONG_READ_RESP);
  }
        gen_read1_id_gen_short_read1_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins gen_read1_id_gen_short_read1_resp_seq = (GEN_READ1 => GEN_SHORT_READ1_RESP);
  }
      gen_read2_id_gen_short_read2_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins gen_read2_id_gen_short_read2_resp_seq = (GEN_READ2 => GEN_SHORT_READ2_RESP);
  }
      dcs_read0_id_dcs_long_read_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins dcs_read0_id_dcs_long_read_resp_seq = (DCS_READ0 => DCS_LONG_READ_RESP);
  }
      dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read1_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read1_resp_seq = (DCS_READ0 => DCS_SHORT_READ1_RESP);
  }
      dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read2_resp_cp: coverpoint data_id{
    option.weight = 1;
    bins dcs_read0_id_dcs_short_read2_resp_seq = (DCS_READ0 => DCS_SHORT_READ2_RESP);
  }
      forward_read_id_resp_read_ack_with_err_cp: coverpoint data_id {
    option.weight = 1;
    bins forward_read_id_resp_read_ack_with_err_seq = (GEN_READ0 => GEN_LONG_READ_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                      (GEN_READ1 => GEN_SHORT_READ1_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                      (GEN_READ2 => GEN_SHORT_READ2_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                      (DCS_READ0 => DCS_LONG_READ_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                      (DCS_READ0 => DCS_SHORT_READ1_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR),
                                                      (DCS_READ0 => DCS_SHORT_READ2_RESP => ACK_WITH_ERR);
  }
 endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_short_packet_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_short_packet_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Packet based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint sync_packet_data_type_cp -- Synchronization Packet Data type:{0x01,0x11,0x21,0x31}
  • coverpoint cmd_packet_data_type_cp -- Command Packet Data type:{0x07,0x16,0x02,0x12,0x22,0x32}
  • coverpoint gen_short_write_data_type_cp -- Generic Short Write Data type:{0x03,0x13,0x23}
  • coverpoint dcs_short_write_data_type_cp -- DCS Short Write Data type:{0x05,0x15}
  • coverpoint read_data_type_cp -- Read Data type:{0x04,0x06,0x14,0x24,0x37}
  • coverpoint ecc_support_cp -- ECC support:{Transmit on/off, Receive on/off}
  • coverpoint transmission_mode_cp -- Packet Transmission Mode:{HS,LP}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_cmd_packet_data_type -- Transmission Mode, Command Packet Data type
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_gen_short_write_data_type -- Transmission Mode, Generic Short Write Data type
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_dcs_short_write_data_type -- Transmission Mode, DCS Short Write Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_sync_packet_data_type -- ECC Support, Synchronization Packet Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_cmd_packet_data_type -- ECC Support, Command Packet Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_gen_short_write_data_type -- ECC Support, Generic Short Write Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_dcs_short_write_data_type -- ECC Support, DCS Short Write Data type
  • cross transmission_mode_vs_read_data_type -- Transmission Mode, Read Data type
  • cross ecc_support_vs_read_data_type -- ECC Support, Read Data type
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_short_packet_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Short Packet Cover Group for Packet based scenerios Coverage";
      sync_packet_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="Synchronization Packet Data type";
    bins data_type_vsync_start_bn = {8'h01};
    bins data_type_vsync_end_bn = {8'h11};
    bins data_type_hsync_start_bn = {8'h21};
    bins data_type_hsync_end_bn = {8'h31};
  }
      cmd_packet_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="Command Packet data type";
    bins data_type_color_mode_off_bn = {8'h02};
    bins data_type_compression_mode_bn = {8'h07};
    bins data_type_color_mode_on_bn = {8'h12};
    bins data_type_execute_queue_bn = {8'h16};
    bins data_type_shutdown_peripheral_bn = {8'h22};
    bins data_type_turn_on_peripheral_bn = {8'h32};
    ignore_bins ignore_data_type_compression_mode_bn = {8'h07} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.compression_enable == 1'b0);
  }
      gen_short_write_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="Generic Short write Data type";
    bins data_type_gen_short_write_0_bn = {8'h03};
    bins data_type_gen_short_write_1_bn = {8'h13};
    bins data_type_gen_short_write_2_bn = {8'h23};
  }
      read_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.bta_enable == 1'b1){
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="Read data type";
    bins data_type_gen_read_0_bn = {8'h04};
    bins data_type_dcs_read_bn = {8'h06};
    bins data_type_gen_read_1_bn = {8'h14};
    bins data_type_gen_read_2_bn = {8'h24};
    bins data_type_set_max_rtn_pkt_size_bn = {8'h37};
  }
      dcs_short_write_data_type_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.forward_data_id {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment="DCS Short write packet";
    bins data_type_dcs_short_write_0_bn = {8'h05};
    bins data_type_dcs_short_write_1_bn = {8'h15};
  }
               transmission_mode_cp:coverpoint dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Transmission Mode [HS,LP] coverage";
    bins transmission_mode_hs_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::HS};
    bins transmission_mode_lp_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT};
  }
        ecc_support_cp: coverpoint { dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_gen_enable, dsi_cfg_data_inst.ecc_recp_enable} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support Coverage";
    bins ecc_enable = {2'b11};
    bins ecc_disable = {2'b00};
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_gen_short_write_data_type:cross transmission_mode_cp ,gen_short_write_data_type_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Transmission Mode and Generic Short Write Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_read_data_type:cross transmission_mode_cp ,read_data_type_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.bta_enable == 1'b1){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Transmission Mode and Read Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      transmission_mode_vs_cmd_packet_data_type:cross transmission_mode_cp,cmd_packet_data_type_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Transmission Mode and Command Packet Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
        transmission_mode_vs_dcs_short_write_data_type:cross transmission_mode_cp ,dcs_short_write_data_type_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Transmission Mode and DCS Short Write Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
        ecc_support_vs_sync_packet_data_type:cross ecc_support_cp,sync_packet_data_type_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and Synchronization Packet Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      ecc_support_vs_cmd_packet_data_type:cross ecc_support_cp,cmd_packet_data_type_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and Command Packet Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
        ecc_support_vs_gen_short_write_data_type:cross ecc_support_cp,gen_short_write_data_type_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT)){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and Generic Short Write Data typeCross Coverage";
  }
      ecc_support_vs_read_data_type:cross ecc_support_cp,read_data_type_cp iff((this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY && (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.bta_enable == 1'b1))|| (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT && (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.bta_enable == 1'b1))){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and Read Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
      ecc_support_vs_dcs_short_write_data_type:cross ecc_support_cp,dcs_short_write_data_type_cp iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::DPHY || (this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.phy_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::CPHY && dsi_data_inst.transmission_mode == svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LPDT )){
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "ECC Support and DCS Short Write Data type Cross Coverage";
  }
   endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_signal_toggling_per_lane_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_signal_toggling_per_lane_cg covergroup definition.
DSI-DPHY coverage per lane based scenerios cover point:
  • coverpoint err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_cp -- If RXValidHS asserts when RxACtiveHS = 1 and RxErrSotHS is detected
  • coverpoint err_sot_sync_rx_valid_rx_active_cp -- If RXValidHS asserts when RxACtiveHS = 1 and RxErrSotSyncHS is detected
  • coverpoint err_sot_sync_rx_valid_deassertion_rx_active_cp -- If RXValidHS de-asserts when RxACtiveHS = 1 and RxErrSotSyncHS is detected
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_signal_toggling_per_lane_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI PPI signal covergroup";
      err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_cp: coverpoint err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_cover {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "RxErrSotHS asserted when RXValidHS and RxActiveHS are high";
    bins err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_1_cp = {4'b0001};
    bins err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_2_cp = {4'b0010};
    bins err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_3_cp = {4'b0100};
    bins err_sot_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_4_cp = {4'b1000};
  }

    bins err_sot_sync_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_2_cp = {4'b0010};
    bins err_sot_sync_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_3_cp = {4'b0100};
    bins err_sot_sync_rx_valid_rx_active_lane_4_cp = {4'b1000};

      err_sot_sync_rx_valid_deassertion_rx_active_cp: coverpoint err_sot_sync_rx_valid_deassertion_rx_active_cover {
    option.weight = 1;

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage::svt_mipi_dsi_video_stream_cg

svt_mipi_dsi_video_stream_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Physical layer cover point:
  • coverpoint video_line_blanking_cp -- Video Line blanking:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint video_frame_blanking_cp -- Video Frame blanking:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint video_frame_size_cp -- Video Frame Size:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint video_line_size_cp -- Video line Size:{Small, Medium, Large}
  • coverpoint long_video_packet_cp -- Forward data Type:[5:0] for Video Packets
  • coverpoint non_burst_mode_cp -- DSI Non Burst Mode Frame Coverage
  • coverpoint burst_mode_cp -- DSI Burst Mode Frame Coverage
  • coverpoint clock_behaviour_cp -- Clock Behaviour {Continuous, Non-continuous}

Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories.
  • cross video_line_blanking_vs_long_video_data_type -- Video Line blanking, Long Video Data type
  • cross video_frame_blanking_long_video_data_type -- Video Frame Blanking, Long Video Data type
  • cross video_line_size_vs_long_video_data_type -- Video Frame Size, Long Video Data type
  • cross long_video_packet_vs_non_burst_mode -- Forward data Type:[5:0] for Video Packets and Non Burst Mode
  • cross long_video_packet_vs_burst_mode -- Forward data Type:[5:0] for Video Packets and Burst Mode Frame
  • cross clock_behaviour_vs_long_video_packet -- Forward data Type:[5:0] for Video Packets and Clock Behaviour
covergroup svt_mipi_dsi_video_stream_cg;
    option.per_instance = 1;
  option.weight = 1;
  type_option.weight = 1;
  type_option.comment = "DSI Video Stream Cover Group for Protocol layer Coverage";
      video_line_blanking_cp:coverpoint frame_blanking_cov {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Video Line blanking";
    bins video_line_blanking_small = {[0:50]};
    bins video_line_blanking_medium = {[51:200]};
    bins video_line_blanking_large = {[201:$]};
  }
      video_frame_blanking_cp:coverpoint num_of_blanking_packet_per_frame {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Video Frame blanking";
    bins video_frame_blanking_small = {[0:9]};
    bins video_frame_blanking_medium = {[10:49]};
    bins video_frame_blanking_large = {[50:$]};
  }
      video_frame_size_cp:coverpoint frame_size_cov {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Video frame size";
    bins video_frame_size_small = {[0:100]};
    bins video_frame_size_medium = {[101:500]};
    bins video_frame_size_large = {[501:$]};
  }
      video_line_size_cp:coverpoint line_size_cov {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Video data line Size:{Small, Medium, Large}";
    bins video_data_line_size_small = {[0:100]};
    bins video_data_line_size_medium = {[101:500]};
    bins video_data_line_size_large = {[501:$]};
  }
      long_video_packet_cp: coverpoint data_type_cov {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Long Video Packet";
    bins packed_pixel_565_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_565};
    bins packed_pixel_888_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_888};
    bins packed_pixel_666_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_666};
    bins loosely_packed_pixel_666_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_666};
    bins loosely_packed_pixel_20_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::LOOSELY_PACKED_PIXEL_20BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_24_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_24BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_16_bits_422_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_16BITS_YCBCR_422};
    bins packed_pixel_101010_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_30BITS_RGB_101010};
    bins packed_pixel_121212_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_36BITS_RGB_121212};
    bins packed_pixel_420_bn = {svt_mipi_dsi_packet::PACKED_PIXEL_12BITS_YCBCR_420};
  }
      non_burst_mode_cp: coverpoint frame_mode_cov {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Non Burst Frame Coverage";
    bins non_burst_sync_pulse_bn = {3'b100};
    bins non_burst_sync_event_bn = {3'b101};
  }
      burst_mode_cp: coverpoint frame_mode_cov{
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "DSI Burst Mode Frame Coverage";
    bins burst_mode_sync_pulse_bn = {3'b110};
    bins burst_mode_sync_event_bn = {3'b111};
  }
      clock_behaviour_cp : coverpoint clock_type
  {
    option.weight = 0;
    type_option.comment = "Clock Behaviour {Continuous, Non-continuous}" ;
    bins continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS};
    bins non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS};
    ignore_bins ignore_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
    ignore_bins ignore_non_continuous_clock_bn = {svt_mipi_lane_configuration::NON_CONTINUOUS} iff(this.dsi_cfg_data_inst.interface_type == svt_mipi_dsi_configuration::PPI);
  }
      clock_behaviour_vs_long_video_packet: cross long_video_packet_cp, clock_behaviour_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Long Video Packets and Clock Behaviour";
  }
      video_line_blanking_vs_long_video_data_type:cross video_line_blanking_cp, long_video_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Video Line Blanking and Long Video Data Type";
  }
     video_frame_blanking_vs_long_video_data_type:cross video_frame_blanking_cp, long_video_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Video Frame Blanking and Long Video Data Type";
  }
     video_line_size_vs_long_video_data_type:cross video_line_size_cp, long_video_packet_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Video Frame Size and Long Video Data Type";
  }
        long_video_packet_vs_non_burst_mode: cross long_video_packet_cp, non_burst_mode_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Long Video Packets and Non Burst Sync Pulse Frame";
  }
      long_video_packet_vs_burst_mode: cross long_video_packet_cp, burst_mode_cp {
    option.weight = 1;
    type_option.comment = "Long Video Packets and Burst Mode Frame";
  }
 endgroup
